body: Formal companion to TAC-OSM ME-006: specify *new* provisional/persistent/quarantine transitions with independently authenticated receipt and PNDS four gates. Prove admission iff eligible, no promotion from unauthenticated evidence, repeated contexts, or missing utility, and finite-real scalar convex recurrence boundedness plus fixed-target refinement contraction. No claim that PNDS v0.2 already defines this transition model, no claim that Lean verifies receipt authenticity, source-data correctness, ML training or overall system safety. CI requires compiled `.olean` file, no `sorry`/`admit`.
